setup.rationale: Larger-timeframe bias is bullish, so I trade with it. The 7479.50-7493.50 Bull/Bear zone is Bias Confirming (7482.50 HVN) and is the realistic downside reach. High hold-odds (plus recap precedent of a strong bounce there) means enter shallow near the top edge to secure fill; stop clears the far edge; target is the Pre-Market Support zone, echoing the recap's own bull/bear-long structure.
